A stick at position X dips into water every $0.80 \text{ s}$, creating a circular wave which travels at a constant speed.
The diagrams show the wave crests at a time $t$ and $1.0 \text{ s}$ later. One of the wave crests, labelled Q, appears in both diagrams.
In each diagram, the distance from X to a wave crest is labelled.
What is the wavelength of the wave?
